principle_violations.reason: The UserService class is directly dependent on the MySQLDatabase class, which violates the Dependency Inversion Principle. Higher-level modules (UserService) should not depend on lower-level modules (MySQLDatabase) but rather depend on abstractions (interfaces).
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface, like UserRepository, that defines the methods for user data operations and have MySQLDatabase implement this interface. UserService should depend on this interface rather than the concrete MySQLDatabase class.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
